text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, February, 13, 2018 Posted by admin on February 13th, 2018 
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -142 points. 
Monday the Dow was up +410.37 (+1.70%) at 24,601.27. 
Year-to-date the Dow is down -0.48%. 
There were 28 Dow stocks up Monday. 
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Apple (AAPL) +4.03% and DowDupont (DWDP) +3.40%. 
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by General Electric (GE) -0.80% and Home Depot (HD) -0.03%. 
European stocks are mostly lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is down one cent at $2.570 per gallon.
